mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and hyperuricemia may potentiate nitrofurantoin toxicity and reduce urinary antimicrobial efficacy; nitrofurantoin requires acidic urine for optimal activity which thiazides may alter.
action: Monitor serum potassium and uric acid levels during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration and consider alternative antihypertensive if hypokalemia develops or UTI recurs.
